_doc: Kit Sense (winning-build plan 2026-11-13, section 3.1; src/kit_sense.py). A hero who knows a family to its Hunter tier ('tier') is told, on first sight of a group of its creatures, the best tool he carries for them: 'Your Silver Mace would serve here.' One line per sighting: a kind counts as sighted again only after it has been out of his sight for 'gap' turns. Nothing is said when his best tool is the one already in his hand. 'lines' by tool kind (a weapon now; the arsenal's coatings and flasks plug in as their own kinds), 'default' for a kind with no lines of its own; the _many pools when several of the kind are in sight. {tool} is the tool's name as the hero knows it, {the} the creature.

weapon: A hunter would reach for the {tool} now.
coating: Your {tool} on the blade would serve here.
Work your {tool} into the edge before {the} closes.
A hunter would coat his weapon with the {tool} now.
flask: A hunter would reach for the {tool} now.

weapon: A hunter would meet these with the {tool}.
coating: Your {tool} on the blade would serve against these.
